UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}' && DB='{{SkympDbName}}' && [ -n \"$DB\" ] && { [ -e \"$DB\" ] || [ -e \"$DB.zip\" ]; } || { echo '[backup] no world yet - nothing to back up'; exit 0; }; mkdir -p backups && STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) && tar -czf backups/world-$STAMP.tar.gz --ignore-failed-read $DB $DB.zip server-settings.json staff.json bans.json whitelist.json 2>/dev/null; echo \"[backup] saved backups/world-$STAMP.tar.gz\"; ls -1t backups/world-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | tail -n +$(( {{BackupsToKeep}} + 1 )) | xargs -r rm -f"

-c "cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}' && if [ -f europia-preflight.js ]; then '{{$FullRootDir}}node/bin/node' europia-preflight.js {{$ServerPort}} {{$UIPort}}; else echo '[preflight] europia-preflight.js not found - run scripts/04-install-into-amp.sh again. Skipping checks.'; fi"
